seoDescription: Explore OpenGov.kz's areas of work in Kazakhstan: open data, public participation, and government transparency. An independent civic initiative.

hero.title: Areas of Work
hero.lead: Open government grows stronger when people can access information, participate in decisions, and scrutinize the work of public authorities.
hero.about: OpenGov.kz is an independent civic initiative. We aim to bring together people and experts who want government information to be accessible, decisions to be understandable, and public participation to be meaningful.

areas.title: Open Data
areas.text: Explore the accessibility and quality of government data, discuss which datasets are most useful to society and businesses, and propose ways to put them to practical use.

areas.title: Public Participation
areas.text: Examine how public consultations and proposal mechanisms work, and what conditions enable people to influence decisions.

areas.title: Government Transparency
areas.text: Consider how easily information about public authorities can be found and used, and discuss approaches to assessing openness.

note: These are potential areas for collaboration, not a list of completed studies or published projects.
